parsed.name: Cytomat 自动化培养箱
parsed.description: 一款用于微孔板和样品托盘自动存取的培养/储存设备，通常配合机械臂使用；支持货架管理、转运位、门体控制、摇床以及温度、CO2、湿度和O2环境控制，常见于细胞培养和自动化实验流程。
parsed.description_en: An automated incubator and storage system for microplates and sample carriers, typically used with robotic handling; it supports rack management, a transfer station, door control, shaking, and environmental control of temperature, CO2, humidity, and O2 for cell culture and automated lab workflows.
